sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Heather Schriever serves as American Fork City Attorney. This page collects appointment records and available council remarks relevant to city legal oversight.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: The City Council unanimously approved Schriever’s appointment as City Attorney on January 14, 2025, and approved a legal-services contract with the Schriever Law Firm at the same meeting. June 2026 minutes list her as the city’s legal counsel.

The compensation table documents Heather Schriever’s prior employment with Orem City from 2014–2023. These amounts are Orem compensation, not payments under American Fork City’s legal-services contract.

sections.title: Council Meeting Remarks
descriptions: Summaries of this official’s remarks that materially concern police accountability, oversight, policy, victim services, major operations, or significant resource decisions. Routine ceremonial mentions and general praise are omitted; each entry links to the relevant discussion and official minutes.
